name: Sword of Sharpness
description: A longsword with an edge so fine it seems to vanish when seen side on.
body:
## What it does

Any sword that cuts can carry this edge; this one is a longsword. Against an object it always deals the most its dice can. On a 20 against a creature it cuts deeper, and if a second d20 also comes up 20 it lops off a limb, if the creature has one to lose.

## Light

Speak its word and the blade sheds bright light for 10 feet and dim light for 10 beyond, until you speak again or sheathe it.

features.name: Sharpness
features.text: Against an object, its damage dice always roll their highest. After a 20 against a creature, roll another d20; on a 20 it loses a limb.
